testcase.name: the cursor is in rows and columns
a change by the user is reported once Compose has applied it
the app's own edit is one step the user can undo, and is reported
the line at the top of the view is the kit's, and setting it is where the view opens
the first line break decides, as in upstream's editor
a load replaces the text, forgets the undo history, is not reported, and keeps the cursor
a change is unreported until Compose has applied it, and a load leaves nothing unreported
typing after a load is reported again
the text is a value that does not change afterwards
a load into a shorter text puts the cursor where the text ends
an offset inside a CRLF lands before the line break
a load keeps the line at the top of the view
a closed buffer reports nothing
an edit of part of the text keeps the file's line breaks
an edit of the whole text takes the line breaks of the text put in
a file written with CR alone keeps CR
the app's edits count a CRLF as the two characters it is on storage
the text is right at once, also before the change is reported
a file written with CRLF keeps CRLF, also in what the user types
